## Definition of Done

- [ ] `./mvnw -B verify` is green locally
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests (`*Test` unit/slice, `*IT` with Testcontainers)
- [ ] No secrets, customer data or prompts/completions in code, logs or fixtures
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, ADR in `docs/adr/` for architectural decisions)
- [ ] CI is green
